definitions.damage: Effective enemy damage, including recorded pets; controlled players excluded as enemies.
definitions.healing: Effective healing and absorbs to players and their pets; overhealing separate.
definitions.sappers: Successful Goblin Sapper Charge cast events (13241).
definitions.sunderArmors: Successful Sunder Armor casts by roster warriors, across all recorded ranks. Debuff applications, stacks and refreshes are not extra casts.
definitions.windfuryTotems: Successful Windfury Totem placement casts by roster shamans (8512, 10613, 10614). Buff applications, pulses, summons and Windfury attacks are not extra drops. Counts measure drops, not uptime.
definitions.friendly: Damage to other players. Self-damage and damage to controlled players are separate.
definitions.nonTankMelee: Landed boss auto-attacks on players outside the inferred tank group. Tank-class players with sustained melee share and recorded taunt users define that group per fight. Recent tank deaths and hits with no surviving tank are excluded. Hits are not proof of threat steals.
definitions.aggro: Conservative boss melee-target switches after stable tanking, with the tank alive. Tank targets, nearby taunts and scripted encounters excluded; inferred boss attention rather than measured threat.
definitions.scope: First-to-last boss windows with intervening trash; five raids through 1 April 2021. Seven upload boundaries aligned using matching events and encounter timestamps.
